dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what do you do in the evening?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt duː juː ˈduː ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I cook and have dinner with my family.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkʊk ənd ˈhæv ˈdɪnər wɪð maɪ ˈfæməli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch TV at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈwɑːtʃ ˌtiːˈviː ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What time do you go to bed?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm duː juː ˈɡoʊ tə ˈbɛd?
